summary: ICEGATE rejected Shipping Bill — IEC mismatch between SB and GSTIN records
root_cause: The Importer-Exporter Code (IEC) on the Shipping Bill (0514056789) does not match the IEC linked to the supplier's GSTIN in the DGFT registry (0514012345). Likely a data entry error during document generation. ICEGATE rejected and requires correction before LEO can be issued.

remediation_steps.description: Identify correct IEC from DGFT registry for supplier GSTIN 36AABCK1234F1Z5
remediation_steps.result: Confirmed correct IEC is 0514012345 from DGFT API

remediation_steps.description: Regenerate Shipping Bill document with corrected IEC
Re-file corrected Shipping Bill to ICEGATE
Confirm LEO issuance from ICEGATE after re-filing

resolution_note: Escalated to HITL for operator to re-file corrected Shipping Bill.
